faqs.question: What is Email to Bank Sync in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Giddh provides an Email to Bank Sync feature that helps users automatically fetch bank statements received through email and process them within the application.

faqs.question: Do I still need to download and upload bank statements manually?
faqs.answer: No. Instead of manually downloading and uploading bank statements, you can configure your bank email integration so that relevant statements are automatically synced into Giddh.

faqs.question: What happens after statements are synced?
faqs.answer: Statements are forwarded from email to Giddh automatically. You can then map the transactions to their respective accounts for further processing and reconciliation.

faqs.question: How does Email to Bank Sync help with reconciliation?
faqs.answer: It reduces manual effort, saves time, and makes bank reconciliation faster and more efficient.

faqs.question: How do I set up Email to Bank Sync?
faqs.answer: Configure your bank email integration in Giddh so relevant statements received through email are synced into the application automatically.

faqs.question: Is this different from other bank integration in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Email to Bank Sync is for bank statements received through email. Giddh also has other bank integration and reconciliation features.
